biggest_catch: The first 125-point reward is not instant: it is applied on the next quarterly date (10th of January, April, July or October) after you join, so the £1.25 credit can take up to ~3 months to arrive.
catches: First 125-point quarterly reward arrives on the next quarterly date (10th of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) after joining — not instantly at signup.
Points can only be redeemed through the ScottishPower app (website signup alone is not enough to redeem).
Must be a ScottishPower domestic energy customer with a live supply and an online account; traditional prepayment meters are excluded.
If you stop being a ScottishPower energy customer, points are permanently removed; if you leave the rewards club but stay a customer you have 28 days to use them.
The annual bonus requires 3+ years as a ScottishPower customer, so a new joiner only gets the quarterly 125 points.

eligibility: ScottishPower domestic energy customer with a live gas and/or electricity supply and an online account. Smart prepayment customers may be eligible; traditional (non-smart) prepayment meters are excluded.
notes: Verified 2026-09-23. My ScottishPower is ScottishPower's free loyalty club: members get 125 points every quarter (January, April, July, October) plus an annual bonus after 3+ years. 100 points = £1 energy credit, so one quarterly reward = £1.25 ≈ $1.67 (GBP→USD 1.334). Redeemable only via the ScottishPower app as energy credit. Distinct mechanism from the ScottishPower refer-a-friend route (R5528).
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (125 points/quarter; 100 points = £1 energy credit → £1.25 ≈ $1.67 at GBP→USD 1.334); time: free loyalty-club signup est. 5–15 min active
payout_quote: Once you have joined My ScottishPower, you'll receive a quarterly reward of 125 points in January, April, July and October, and an annual bonus if you've been with us for over 3 years. Reward points can only be redeemed in the app. Points can be redeemed as an energy credit on your account, 100 points equal to £1 energy credit, saving you money on your energy bill.
payout_value_note: 125 quarterly points = £1.25 energy credit (100 points = £1); converted at GBP→USD 1.334 → $1.67. Only the first quarterly reward is counted as the signup-attributable payout.

steps: Log in to your ScottishPower online account (register for one if you don't have it).
Sign up for My ScottishPower via the website or the ScottishPower app (accept the Terms and Conditions, click 'Join My ScottishPower').
Download the ScottishPower app if you haven't — points can only be redeemed in the app.
Receive 125 points on the next quarterly date (10th of January, April, July or October).
Redeem points in the app as energy credit; credit shows as 'My ScottishPower Credit' on your bill within 14 days.
timing: 125 points applied on the 10th of January, April, July and October following signup; energy credit applied to the bill within 14 days of redeeming points in the app.
